1.t: By the heaven and the nightly star

2.t: And what will make you realize what the nightly star is

3.t: ˹It is˺ the star of piercing brightness

4.t: There is no soul without a vigilant angel ˹recording everything˺

5.t: Let people then consider what they were created from

6.t: ˹They were˺ created from a spurting fluid

7.t: stemming from between the backbone and the ribcage

8.t: Surely He is fully capable of bringing them back ˹to life˺

9.t: on the Day all secrets will be disclosed

10.t: Then one will have neither power nor ˹any˺ helper
10.tr: Famaa lahoo min quwwatinw Wa-laa naasir

11.t: By the sky with its recurring cycles

12.t: and the earth with its sprouting plants

13.t: Surely this ˹Quran˺ is a decisive word

14.t: and is not to be taken lightly

17.t: So bear with the disbelievers ˹O Prophet˺. Let them be for ˹just˺ a little while
